context: Evaluates edge-case handling: repeated free-text 'Other' answers signaling a mismatched curated set, and a later answer that conflicts with an earlier one.

checklist.name: Pivots after repeated Other
checklist.description: After two consecutive free-text 'Other' answers, the next question shifts to an open question instead of a third curated guess

checklist.name: Contradiction surfaced plainly
checklist.description: The Turn 1 versus Turn 3 conflict is surfaced explicitly to the user rather than silently resolved

checklist.name: User asked which holds
checklist.description: The agent asks the user which of the two conflicting answers should stand, rather than guessing

checklist.name: Recap reflects resolution only
checklist.description: The recap reflects only the answer the user confirms after the contradiction is raised, with no invented compromise

checklist.name: Protocol maintained under edge case
checklist.description: One-question-at-a-time and free-text availability are preserved throughout the edge case
